hypothesis: value-ranked body assembly retains more typed facts than chronological body + char cut at identical budgets

design.corpus: buildScript(seed, stages:3, facts:30, noiseLines:90) + dominant-template noise events
design.scored: all non-trap facts, loose + strict calibers

diagnosis: Baseline measurement killed the original framing: the appendix budget is not the binding constraint between 3K-24K for retention — the per-event extraction and the body assembly ORDER are. A chronological character cut keeps whichever events come first, so a fact-dense late event is dropped entirely at every budget (facts-last layout: 0-2/164) while the interleaved layout survives on the luck of hosting the first plant event (84/164). Value ranking is layout-invariant at every budget (identical scores in both layouts).

decision.rationale: Worst-case (min over layouts) value dominates at EVERY budget: 3000:26/164 vs 0/164; 5000:38 vs 1; 8000:80 vs 2; 12000:136 vs 2; 16000+:164 vs 2. Mean-wise value trails only at <=5K (77/52 vs 85/84), driven by the interleaved lottery; the production appendix budget (24K minus model summary, typically 12-21K) sits deep in the region where value strictly dominates on both mean and worst case.
decision.liveConfirmation: maintainer adjudication 2026-08-19: the deterministic offline paired matrix (328 runs, both layouts, six budgets) remains the primary paired evidence; the live matrix contributed one fully clean pair (zh-1: appendix +14.3pp value-over-chronological, blind parity 28/28) plus ~44 arm-runs of pilot observation with zero end-to-end regressions, and is recorded with its protocol lessons. Default 'value' ships; safetyIndexRanking: 'chronological' is the documented escape.

crossoverNote: At <=5K the whole-line greedy plus one partial line cannot beat a chronological slice of a fat first plant line; both regimes are far below the production budget floor.

live.protocol: facts-last corpus; 1 telemetry message + 12 plant stage turns; single instructed compress (summary <= 2000 chars hint); blind audit; validity requires the appendix budget to bind, exactly one model-written compaction, no retrieval tools, <= 20 calls
live.builds: both arms 0.2.0-beta.12; variants differ only by safetyIndexRanking overlay; same homes and model route
lessons: the appendix budget binds or not depends on the model summary length at compress time (lottery across arms); binding must be an explicit validity flag, not an assumption
seed en-1 made the model compress multiple times despite the exactly-once instruction (protocol non-compliance, both variants equally)
some invalid arms ended with an empty final compaction event (modelChars 0) after repeated compression attempts
blind recall saturated (26-28 of 26-28) in every protocol-valid arm because the model summary independently carried the facts at these corpus sizes; the appendix layer is where the policies differ
